decisions.reason: The source requests that shower, sink, and door dimensions be shown on the dimensioned plan; it does not change the en-suite bathroom's layout, fixtures, or locations.
Showing shower dimensions is a drawing-documentation change and does not alter Unit 3 bathroom geometry or the shower's left-wall location.
The source concerns displaying shower, sink, and door dimensions and does not change any open-plan kitchen cabinetry requirement.
The request to display fixture and door dimensions does not modify the placement, construction, demolition, or removal of partition walls.
The dimension-display request neither changes the corridor layout nor resolves the existing entrance-hall design ambiguity.
